summary: Korn Ferry filed a Form 8-K on September 9, 2026, recasting historical segment disclosures to reflect a geographic realignment effective May 1, 2026, into Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific segments. No restatement or amendment occurred; consolidated financial position, results, and cash flows are unchanged. Exhibit 99.1 updates prior 10-K items covering business, risk factors, MD&A, and notes on segments and acquisitions. No transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock is present. Watch for comparability issues in segment-level models, not deal risk-arb.
